answer: A sybil-resistant economy can price identities on a self-declared ladder. Each operator registers its keys as one orchard, and the k-th key in an orchard locks 10×k² POA: one agent locks 10, the 100th key 100,000, and a 1,000-key farm about 3.3 billion. The obvious dodge is running each clone as an island outside any orchard, so funding and timing links are logged each epoch; a linked island is folded back in, re-pricing the whole orchard and slashing triple the shortfall. Weakness: a gale of honest newcomers on one cloud host may be falsely linked, so appeals post a 50 POA bond.
